hook: An exhibition opening at the Musée de Cluny reveals how Nicolas Flamel built his legendary wealth.

sections.voiceover: An exhibition opening at the Musée de Cluny reveals how Nicolas Flamel built his legendary wealth.
b_roll: Exterior shot of the Musée de Cluny in Paris

sections.voiceover: Parisian records reveal ordinary medieval wealth instead of alchemical gold. Writers spent 600 years transforming him into a legend. Where did the manuscripts stored in the Science Museum come from?
b_roll: Historical parchment documents in Paris archives

sections.voiceover: New research into the will of Nicolas Flamel reveals the origins of his legend.
b_roll: Close up of medieval handwriting on vellum

sections.voiceover: Pernelle Flamel shared property records detailing actual investments. Le Trésor des Trésors preserved those notebooks around 1700. Opening day arrives on 13 October 2026.
b_roll: Le Trésor des Trésors manuscript opened to an alchemical illustration
Exhibition gallery banner with date 13 October 2026

sections.voiceover: Visit the Paris exhibition opening on 13 October 2026 to see the documents yourself.
b_roll: Interior view of exhibition display cases
